evidence.summary: The 30-test service-core integration suite now asserts cursor-only polling cannot resume a nonzero cursor without stream identity.
EventHub treats a missing stream identity with a nonzero cursor as reset-required rather than accepting ambiguous history.

reproduction.instructions: Run the service-core integration test restart_reconciles_offline_edit_without_reusing_cursor_alone and request a nonzero cursor through poll_events without stream_identity; confirm reset_required and the event-stream identity limitation.

summary: Cursor-only resume is now fail-closed: a nonzero cursor without its explicit event-stream identity returns reset_required, while cursor-zero initial polling remains compatible.

workaround.description: No cursor-only restart workaround remains; clients must carry the explicit stream identity for nonzero cursor resumes.
